issue_context.title: Add individual options for amount of clicks to open files and folders
issue_context.body:
### What's the Problem?

There is currently an option to open items with a single click, some users might want additional customization in this area to configure files and folders differently.

### Solution/Idea

Adding a second option to "Open files with a single click" should resolve this issue.

### Alternatives

na

### Priorities

| Capability | Priority |
| :---------- | :------- |
| This proposal will change the current setting to only apply to folders | Must |
| This proposal will add an option to open files with a single click | Must |

### Files Version

v2.0.15

### Windows Version

Windows 11

### Additional comment

_No response_
comments: Correct, I would like to have single click for folders (Column view) but still double click for files. I think it is the same behavior with the Mac OS Finder. Also when I move the keyboard arrows up and down, it should open the folder. But this seems another issue, probably.

review_comments: Null check (`if (item == null)`) of line 475 to be moved up here. It was added iirc cause clicking on the columnview empty space or similar would cause a crash.
